plugins.name: stackin
plugins.description: Issue and manage Brazilian fiscal documents from your AI client — NF-e and NFS-e, DANFE PDFs, rejections and cancellations — over the hosted Stackin MCP server.

plugins.name: stackin
plugins.description: Emita e gerencie notas fiscais brasileiras — NF-e e NFS-e — com a Stackin.

skills.name: cancel-invoice
skills.description: Cancel an authorized fiscal document, or file a correction letter when cancelling is not what the situation needs.
headings: Cancelling, and what is not cancelling
When cancelling is the wrong tool
skills.description_zh: 取消已获批准的财政单据，若情况不适合取消则提交更正函。

skills.name: consult-invoice
skills.description: Find a fiscal document and report its current state, by access key or by searching the company's history.
headings: When the person has the access key
skills.description_zh: 按访问 key 或公司历史查找财政单据并报告当前状态。

skills.name: correct-invoice
skills.description: File a correction letter (CC-e) against an authorized NF-e — and know when a correction is not what the situation needs.
headings: What a CC-e can and cannot do
skills.description_zh: 对已批准 NF-e 提交 CC-e 更正函，并判断何时不应使用更正。

skills.name: diagnose-invoice
skills.description: Explain why a fiscal document was rejected and what has to change, using what the tax authority actually answered.
skills.description_zh: 依据税务机关实际回复解释财政单据拒绝原因及需要调整的内容。

skills.name: fiscal-lookup
skills.description: Resolve an NCM, CFOP, CEST or other published fiscal code before it goes on a document, instead of guessing one.
skills.description_zh: 在开具单据前查证 NCM、CFOP、CEST 等公开财政代码，不猜测编码。

skills.name: invalidate-numbering
skills.description: Declare an NF-e numbering range that was reserved and never used, so the gap is explained to the SEFAZ.
skills.description_zh: 向 SEFAZ 声明已预留但从未使用的 NF-e 编号区间，解释编号空缺。

skills.name: issue-invoice
skills.description: Issue a Brazilian fiscal document — an NF-e for goods or an NFS-e for services — checking the data before it reaches the tax authority.
skills.description_zh: 开具巴西货物 NF-e 或服务 NFS-e，在提交税务机关前校验数据。

skills.name: received-invoices
skills.description: Read the NF-e documents other companies issued against this one, and file the company's position on them.
headings: The four positions, and what each one claims
skills.description_zh: 读取其他公司向本公司开具的 NF-e，并申报本公司对这些单据的立场。

skills.name: taxpayer-lookup
skills.description: Confirm who a tax id belongs to before invoicing them, by exact match against the taxpayer registry.
headings: Checking who a tax id belongs to
A 404 is not proof the company does not exist
skills.description_zh: 通过纳税人登记库精确匹配税号，开票前确认对应主体。

headings: Connect from Cursor or any MCP client
